messages:
eva: Quick heads-up: planning to unpin SDK 3.2 in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. Found a quant/kernel mismatch affecting qv2-legacy models; runtime needs a sticky pin until a microkernel patch lands. Need rollout plan + rollback triggers.
mike: Proposal: stagger unpin for non-qv2 first, keep runtime pinned for model-group:qv2-legacy. :+1:
jen: Agreed. Add holdlist for qv2-legacy and route them to runtime 2.14.1 as fallback. We need telemetry for perf and quality.
lucas: I'll add holdlist and pin runtime. opsctl: `opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --type model --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z`
jen: And runtime pin: runtime:2.14.1+kvcache for qv2 group.
lucas: Committing runtime sticky pin now and contacting infra for capacity reservation.
sre-ops: Reserving 2 canary pods eu-west-1 + 1 eu-central for warmup. Healthchecks=200req/s. I'll attach runbook.
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Rollout slices: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m.
mike: Rollback criteria: 1) 5xx > +0.5% vs baseline, 2) p95 latency > +30% for qv2-legacy after routing, 3) token-error-rate or OOM spike. Abort & re-pin if hit.
jen: Add: eval-quality drift on core prompts > 4% (we'll run small prompt set every 5m). Alert #incidents.
sre-ops: Will create monitoring queries and alerts. Recommend 20m cooldown between slices.
lucas: Runtime pin created: `OK: runtime pin id=pin-8392 target=runtime:2.14.1+kvcache scope=model-group:qv2-legacy expires=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z`
eva: I'll draft release notes and include rollback guidance. Mike: call out cost/latency impact?
mike: Yes. Note expected p95 bump ~10-15% for qv2 while pinned and likely higher GPU utilization.
deploy-bot: escape hatch: `deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason "telemetry-trigger"`
jen: Ops checklist pre-23:00: 1) holdlist present 2) runtime pin active 3) canaries healthy 4) metrics + eval alerts configured 5) release notes drafted 6) on-call alerted.
lucas: Holdlist & pin done, waiting for canary warmup.
sre-ops: Warming canaries now, ETA ~9m.
deploy-bot: started: SDK unpin (slice 10%). Canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. Monitoring linked.
mike: Monitoring looks clean so far. Keep watching p95 and TER.
sre-ops: pod-2 now healthy, moving to 40% per plan in 15m. Ready to abort on alert.
je n: If rollback required, update customer docs and notify support. Who owns that?
eva: I'll ping CS/support with playbook and a short customer note.
lucas: Postmortem note: root cause = quant kernel selection mismatch in runtime optimization pass; patch queued.
mike: After EU unpin completes, schedule compatibility smoke for other model groups in 48h before global unpin.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. No rollback triggered.
